purpose: Cover the 5 RSA×AES padding combos not exercised in Round 7. With Round 7's pkcs1+pkcs7 baseline, this completes the 3 RSA paddings × 2 AES paddings = 6-combo matrix.
scheme: Hybrid RSA + AES (per PNPKI spec). All 5 slots vary only on RSA padding and AES padding; everything else identical to Round 7.

decision_table.Round 7 PASS: pkcs1 + pkcs7 is canonical. Round 8 may produce additional passes (defensive interop).
decision_table.Round 7 FAIL + Round 8 has PASS: The passing slot's (rsa, aes) tuple is canonical.
decision_table.Both rounds all FAIL: RSA padding / AES padding not the differentiator. Investigate key1/key2 ordering, AES key derivation, or request a fresh production PEM.
